description.other: Send plain text or Markdown with Bot identity. Specify receive_id + receive_id_type=chat_id or a group reply_to_message_id to use the current Session’s bound Bot. For a private message to the login in the current isolated Feishu Session, use receive_id_type=self where a personal Bot is configured. Requires user authorization for the destination and content. Returns message_id.

receive_id.other: Group chat ID; omit for replies and receive_id_type=self.

receive_id_type.other: Use chat_id with a group receive_id, or self without a receive_id or reply fields to reach the isolated user’s verified login.

reply_to_message_id.other: Group message ID to reply to; mutually exclusive with recipient fields. Private-chat replies are disabled.

reply_in_thread.other: Reply within a topic; only valid with reply_to_message_id. Defaults to false.

text.other: Message body, preserved verbatim. Use format=markdown for rich text. Encoded content, including the rich-text envelope, must not exceed 20 KiB.

uuid.other: Optional deduplication key, at most 50 bytes. Reuse with identical destination, format and content on retries; Feishu deduplicates for one hour.

destination.other: Specify receive_id and receive_id_type, or reply_to_message_id; do not combine them.

id_type.other: receive_id_type must be chat_id or self.

session.other: Feishu messaging requires the current bound Session and its agent credential.

unbound.other: The Session has no active Feishu Bot binding.

ambiguous.other: The Session is bound to multiple Feishu Bots; resolve the bindings before sending.

unavailable.other: The bound Feishu Bot is unavailable.

lookup.other: Cannot resolve the Session’s Feishu Bot: %s

empty_response.other: Feishu returned no message ID; delivery is uncertain. Retry only with the same uuid.

format.other: Body format: text (default) or markdown. Markdown uses Feishu rich text and its supported syntax; images are not downloaded or uploaded.

invalid_format.other: format must be text or markdown.

group_only.other: The Session’s bound Feishu Bot only sends to group chats.

destination_lookup.other: Cannot verify the destination group; no message was sent: %s

destination_metadata.other: Feishu returned incomplete or unknown destination metadata; no message was sent.

self_destination.other: Use receive_id_type=self without receive_id or reply fields.

personal_session.other: Personal Bot delivery requires the calling user’s own Linux DAC isolated Feishu Session.

personal_schedule.other: Personal Bot delivery requires a verified schedule creator running under their own isolated identity.

personal_unavailable.other: Personal Bot delivery is unavailable on this Runtime.

personal_login.other: Could not verify the isolated user’s Feishu login. Check the personal CLI profile and sign-in status.

personal_bot.other: The personal Bot send did not return a confirmed delivery. Check the Bot’s send permission and availability. Retry only with the same uuid.
